purpose: 동일 full-native-L4 손상에서 층별 repair 가능성 측정

capsule.preservation_teacher: fixed W0 Teacher192; verify same model/token binding
capsule.teacher_regeneration: only if identity/effective distribution check requires it; no generation performed by this design

anchor.chain: N4 only; full native local-z4 writes; no repair committed
anchor.reuse_existing_cold_N4_checkpoint: only after source/model/token/order/history/teacher hash binding is verified

layers.outside_controls_justification: L9 adjacent outside window; L12 separated downstream control, not proven optimal
layers.L4_repair: excluded by frozen writer condition; REFIT4 is separate

cells.W4_and_nonselected_parameters: exact WN throughout candidate evaluation and restoration

data.Past64: received latest active fact; excludes current overwrites; hash priority; no success filtering
data.Past_prompt_scope: canonical rewrite only; no paraphrase expansion
data.native_context_policy: keep existing native writer contexts; do not create a paraphrase guard set

quality.mean_NLL_ceiling: each panel own WN mean + epsilon_L

gradients: Past canonical mean NLL if nonempty
direction_space.orthonormalization: FP64 Gram/QR; preserve resolved gradient span; drop numerical zero/dependency
direction_space.direction_scope_failure: not intrinsic capacity failure of the selected layer

trust.solver_family: small convex QCQP / SOCP; linear edit guards plus ellipsoid
trust.metric: Htilde_l = Base-output GN restricted to Q_l + minimal numerical diagonal damping
trust.tau0: B(WN), identical across layers at the same anchor
trust.constraint: 0.5 * c^T Htilde_l c <= tau; whitened ||u||_2 <= sqrt(2*tau)
trust.guards: same rewrite mean/margin linearization as main method; zero model mean slack
trust.m_zero_or_tau_below_epsilon: zero; no divide by m and no fabricated gain
trust.gain_comparison: Gamma_free and Gamma_safe use identical layer, basis, objective, Htilde and tau; never mix accepted radii

probe_policy.candidate_state_always: same WN plus one layer correction
probe_policy.controller_choice: first acceptable guarded proposal in descending tau order; or zero
probe_policy.acceptance: first finite quality-feasible candidate with predicted>epsilon_B, actual>epsilon_B, actual/predicted>=0.1
probe_policy.observer_after: seal proposal identities, acceptance flags and controller choice before official P/N and Dev128
probe_policy.cross_layer_online_winner: not committed or prescribed by this diagnosis

numerical_checks.two_scale_central_FD: each retained basis direction; Base derivative and all guard scalar JVPs

cost_structure.new_native_L4_writes: up to 10 batches if verified existing N4 anchors unavailable

reporting.capacity_claim: local repair headroom in tested response basis; not remaining edit count or intrinsic layer capacity
reporting.failure_scope: three-direction family and tested numerical controller only
reporting.development_vs_test: if observer results influence global method selection, these data are development; independent held-out evaluation requires disjoint locked data/order strategy
reporting.long_horizon: not tested by independent-cell study; needs subsequent cold lifelong repaired trajectories

next_stage.dynamic_layer_if: finite safe gains change across batches and selection benefit justifies cost; separate locked follow-up
next_stage.lifelong_main_blocked_until: layer and solver policy fixed with numerical/model evidence; no automatic job submission
